name: PolarBlock breathable membrane
covers: Put on the outside face of each OSB sheet at the shop, before the sheet goes on the CNC: it is cut out with the panel. Every exterior wall, and each pod's own SIP wall where two pods join (no siding there). Not on the steel frame, floors or roof.
note: Print scale assumed: the dashed lines 12″ apart (the picture 48″ wide). Roll sizes (membrane and tape) to confirm.

tape.name: PolarBlock seam tape
tape.note: same product as the membrane, darker blue, 3″ wide, centred over every joint between exterior panels
